`$file->fscanf('%d %s')` was `Undefined method`. php has had it since 5.1, it is
the object form of the `fscanf()` this branch just rebuilt, and a program that
uses it does not compile at all.

It is one line through the shared scanf engine, so the method and the free
function cannot drift — `%d` comes back as an INT on both. The LINE NUMBER rule
is php's own and is NOT `fgets()`'s: measured on `php -n` 8.5.6, the FIRST
